en.description: A context database for AI agents: memory, resources and skills in one place
en.notes: Open https://{host}/studio/settings and paste the root key: it is OPENVIKING_ROOT_API_KEY in the project’s .env. Then create an account and a user at /studio/users: the user’s key is what the ov CLI, the SDKs and agents use. Embeddings and summaries go to OpenAI with your key. Data and ov.conf are kept in /app/.openviking.
